name: Basecamp
tagline: The core loop is buildable, but a dependable replacement becomes a real weekend or multi-day project. For Basecamp, organize projects around messages, to-dos, files, schedules, and check-ins. The hard boundary is mature opinionated workflow, email delivery, guest access, support, and reliability, plus collaboration, integrations, and organizational trust.
